metadata.description: Kirei — specialized research + execute agent team for Claude Code

plugins.name: kirei
plugins.description: Specialized research + execute agent team. /kirei auto-detects task type (security, UI, refactor, performance, architecture, test, migrate, review, debug, data, deps, observability, bundle, license, resilience, eval, or general via kirei-research) and complexity, spawns the right specialist to investigate, then an execute agent — kirei-stitch (focused) or kirei-loom (multi-file) — to implement. Also: /kirei-prism (parallel multi-lens research), /kirei-audit (depth-tunable code-quality audits with ordered fixes), /kirei-deps (Dependabot-aware dependency-safety audits), /kirei-sentry (production Sentry setup), /kirei-templatize (repo to starter template), /kirei-discuss (pre-code idea audit), and /kirei-wave (worktree-parallel multi-slice execute: fan-out builders, run the gate battery, open PRs, gate each with the read-only adversarial kirei-gate reviewer, then merge in dependency order). kirei-resilience audits error handling.
